question: Who will be the 2026 Time Person of the Year?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: Time POY winners 1927-2025 — non-election years go mostly to world leaders, popes, notable groups or concepts, with a substantial unpredictable 'other' share. Markets: Polymarket ($159k) has Mamdani 26%, Carney 17%, Pope Leo 15%, Netanyahu 9%, Amodei/Trump 8%, Rubio 7%, AI 7%, Musk 6%, Artemis astronauts ~5% each; Kalshi (~$9.5M cross-venue, per an aggregator) has Mamdani ~28.5%, Pope ~15.5%. I shade Mamdani down (a city mayor is an unusual pick), cut AI (2025 was already AI), pool the Artemis II crew into Astronaut(s), and keep Other substantial given the long tail and the clause that a group naming multiple listed people resolves Other.
calls.dossier:
- Polymarket 'TIME Person of the Year 2026' multi-outcome market (28 outcomes, ~$159k volume, checked 2026-10-24): Mamdani is the market leader, followed by Carney, Pope Leo XIV, Netanyahu, Amodei, Trump, Rubio, AI, Musk; Artemis II crew members (Glover, Koch, Wiseman) are listed individually at low single digits each. Full resolution rules not visible.
- Kalshi KXTIME-26 also has Mamdani leading and Pope Leo second (via prediction.com aggregator, 2026-10; ~$9.5M cross-venue volume). Kalshi page returned 429.
- Mamdani: became NYC's 112th mayor in Jan 2026; national profile from pushback against Trump immigration enforcement (covers.com, olbg, 2026).
- Carney: Canadian PM since 2025; his odds jumped after a European trip; prominent on trade and US relations (Yahoo Canada, 2026).
- Pope Leo XIV: first American-born pope (elected May 2025, not picked for POY 2025); on TIME100 2026; a diplomatic voice on war, migration and AI (covers.com).
- 2025 POY was 'The Architects of AI' (group incl. Musk, Huang, Altman, Amodei) — Time seldom repeats a theme in consecutive years.
- Altman's market odds halved in 72h in late July 2026; papal developments affected Amodei's price (prediction.com).
- Artemis II crewed lunar flyby flew in 2026; Apollo 8 crew precedent (1968).
- Trump was POY in 2016 and 2024; 2026 is a US midterm year, not a presidential one.
- Popes picked 3 times (most recently Francis 2013, his first year); a US mayor picked once (Giuliani 2001, after 9/11).
- Resolution: a group with 2+ listed individuals -> Other; any AI concept/company/model -> Artificial Intelligence; an astronaut group -> Astronaut(s). Resolves off Time's December announcement, not off markets.
- Event window: announcement expected early-mid Dec 2026; as of 2026-10-24 about 82% of the calendar year has elapsed and roughly 7 weeks remain before the announcement.
- Searched, absent: a Time 2026 shortlist (usually released in early December); the market's full rules text.

calls.reasoning: Base rate: Time picks world leaders and newsmakers of the year, and its choices often surprise; prediction-market favorites win well short of a majority. Markets (Polymarket ~$159k, Kalshi ~$1.9M) price Mamdani ~27%, Carney/Leo ~15%, Netanyahu ~9%, Trump/Amodei ~8%. Shaded Mamdani down (first-year city mayor; enthusiast-driven pricing, already falling from 33-37% in Aug/Sep), AI/Amodei/Musk down (AI theme chosen 2025; group with several listed people resolves Other), Leo down (2nd year). Trump kept at 10% (US-Iran war from Feb 28, midterms). Other raised to 22% for the long tail: Iran figures, midterm figures, cultural picks, group or concept selections.

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Time POY 2000-2025 — 'Other'/unlisted people and groups win most often; sitting US presidents with dominant years win often (Trump 2016/2024, Bush 2000/2004, Obama 2008/2012). 2026's defining story is the US-Israel war on Iran (Feb 28 strikes killed Ali Khamenei), ordered by Trump, so Trump is the strongest single name, discounted for his 2024 win. Thin markets lead with Mamdani (Polymarket 26%, ~$159k total book; William Hill 7/4), but a first-year city mayor is historically rare (only Giuliani 2001) and his late-Oct coverage is negative (one bill signed). AI was chosen in 2025, so a repeat is unlikely. Pope Leo was passed over in 2025, his debut year. 'Other' covers Ebola fighters (2014 precedent), Iran-related figures, mediators and midterm winners. Markets checked: Polymarket multi-outcome 2026 event (matches the question's terms, but each contract is thin), William Hill.

Any group containing two or more listed individuals resolves Other. Any astronaut or astronaut group resolves Astronaut(s). AI as a concept, AI models or AI companies resolve Artificial Intelligence. Mojtaba Khamenei was named successor Mar 7. Ceasefire Apr 7-8. Pakistan-mediated interim deal Jun 14 (Hormuz reopened, 60-day halt). The USS Abraham Lincoln returned home Oct 8 after a long Iran deployment.

In October 2026 he drew criticism for signing only one bill in ten months (CBS affiliates/Yahoo, Oct 22-23) and stood by an Oct 7 post that angered Jewish leaders (WaPo, Oct 8). Time has named a city mayor once (Giuliani 2001).
- Mark Carney: betting previews cite his role in global-order and US-pressure debates. No single defining 2026 event was found.

calls.reference_class: Time Person of the Year selections 2000-2025, bucketed by type (US president, foreign leader, group/concept, tech figure, other)

calls.reasoning: Time POY in non-presidential-election years goes mostly to world leaders, popes, groups/concepts, with a large unpredictable tail. Human markets lead with Mamdani (WH 7/4, ~26-33% prediction markets), then Pope Leo/Carney, Trump 7/1 at WH. I shade Mamdani well below market (first-year city mayor, only Giuliani precedent, negative Oct coverage, enthusiast pricing; market contracts also pay on group inclusion). Trump is the dominant 2026 newsmaker (Feb 28 Iran strikes killed Khamenei, midterms) but won in 2024 and a war-themed pick may be a group, resolving Other. AI repeat unlikely after 2025. Other kept large for Iran figures, Ebola fighters, midterm figures, multi-listed groups.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: Trump's weight (run 3 17% vs 7-10%), Mamdani shading (11-20%), Pope Leo, Other size. Checked: (1) Iran war facts — confirmed via CNBC/Wikipedia that Feb 28 2026 US-Israel strikes killed Khamenei, Trump announced it; supports Trump as central newsmaker. (2) Current odds — William Hill Oct 23: Mamdani 7/4, Pope Leo and Trump 7/1; predictionhunt aggregator Mamdani 33%; Kalshi news piece earlier had Trump 21-28% near-tied with Mamdani/Leo at 20%, Trump since faded. Market contracts resolve Yes on group inclusion, unlike this question's group->Other rule, so they are evidence not anchor. Judgment: Mamdani below market but above run 3; Trump between runs given war dominance vs 2024 repeat and group-pick risk; Other 25%.
